errors.text: The fracture-morphology direction is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed or isolated microcracking rather than elongated interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts a transition from isolated to elongated cracks and assigns isolated cracks to the brittle baseline.
The principal mechanical outcome—approximately 1150 MPa strength together with about 36% uniform elongation and near-doubling of both properties—is omitted.

The cited evidence does not directly establish the claimed HPHT transformation in Al0.7CoCrFeNi; E1 concerns a different refractory alloy and processing route, while E2 concerns a different composition without HPHT treatment.
